PluginData.Author: CometWorks
PluginData.Tooltip: Space Engineers cluster: regular node hosting partitions (dedicated server)
PluginData.Description: Turns this dedicated server into a regular node of a Space Engineers cluster: it registers with the cluster Gateway, hosts the partitions handed to it, serves the loopback control endpoint and follows the World Authority for global state and time. Configured entirely by the CLUSTER_* environment variables set by the cluster CLI (docs/EnvVars.md of the deployment archive). Requires the Direct Transport plugin.
